# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run references`; edit its sources, not this file. -->

This generated reference is for users looking up an exact command, flag, exit code or diagnostic. It is generated from the CLI, so it matches this version; `cockpit <command> --help` shows the same flags.

Each diagnostic message names what failed and how to fix it. For each command, What to do repeats a fix that never changes and links the [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md) section that covers the code; the other codes are listed on their own, and their message is the guidance. [Respond to diagnostic codes](environment.md#respond-to-diagnostic-codes) explains each family of codes.

Each command lists the codes its code path can produce, derived from the source rather than observed, and the lists err towards too many. A list can name a code that needs a failure your setup never meets, and, where commands are built from the same shared parts, a code only a related command raises. A code a command prints that its list does not name is a defect in this page.

Every command can produce these codes, so they are listed once, here, and not under each command:

| Diagnostic |
| --- |
| `CLI_INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| `CLI_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED` |
| `CLI_USAGE_INVALID` |

## cockpit init

Preview, then accept, a first cockpit setup for one agent tool.

Does not read `cockpit.toml`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--target` | string | unset |
| `--registry` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--answers` | string | unset |
| `--accept-preview` | string | unset |
| `--accept-defaults` | string | unset |
| `--reset-answer` | string | unset |
| `--accept-reset` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `COCKPIT_LAUNCHER_UNPROVEN` | run cockpit as ./node_modules/.bin/cockpit <command> --config <your cockpit.toml> from the cockpit root, or remove what stops npx from proving it: a .npmrc in the cockpit root, a bin or directories.bin in its package.json, or a node_modules/.bin/cockpit that npm install did not link to the installed package |
| `CODEX_HOOK_UNTRUSTED` | if you use Codex in this cockpit, a person runs codex -C <cockpit root> in a terminal (not codex exec), trusts the folder if asked, and chooses "Trust all and continue" when Codex shows "Hooks need review" (or enables and trusts the hook in its /hooks view); then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `DOCUMENT_GUARD_HOSTS_NONE` | list the hosts in guards.hosted_db_hosts and guards.vendor_endpoint_hosts and run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> once a non-local environment exists |
| `DOCUMENT_RUNTIME_NOT_DECLARED` | once a product runs, declare environment.compose_files or [environment.generated] and run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EVALUATOR_UNAVAILABLE` | install the Codex CLI with npm install -g @openai/codex, sign in with codex login, then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit setup

Clone or locate the declared sibling repositories and link them.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--write-instruction-pointers` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `REGISTRY_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#harness-surface-failures) |
| `REGISTRY_INPUT_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#harness-surface-failures) |
| `SETUP_CLONE_FAILED` | check that this machine can reach the remote (git ls-remote <remote>) and that the sibling remote in cockpit.toml is right, or clone it into the named directory yourself; then run npx --no cockpit setup --config <your cockpit.toml> again |
| `SETUP_INSTRUCTION_POINTER_OFFERED` | review the proposed AGENTS.md block, then run npx --no cockpit setup --config <your cockpit.toml> --write-instruction-pointers |
| `SETUP_MANUAL_MISSING` | create the checkout, then run npx --no cockpit setup --config <your cockpit.toml> again; [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `SETUP_REMOTE_MISMATCH` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `SETUP_REMOTE_UNRESOLVABLE` | make the remote path readable, or declare the remote as a URL or an absolute path to an existing repository, then run npx --no cockpit setup --config <your cockpit.toml> again |
| `STATE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#clear-cockpit-state) |
| `STATE_RECORD_MALFORMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#clear-cockpit-state) |

| Other diagnostics |

| `CONFIG_CHANGED_DURING_EXECUTION` |

## cockpit sibling

Add or remove a repository in cockpit.toml (sibling add, sibling remove).

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--create` | boolean | `false` |
| `--from` | string | unset |
| `--remote` | string | unset |
| `--dir` | string | unset |
| `--var` | string | unset |
| `--purpose` | string | unset |
| `--mount` | string | unset |
| `--instruction-pointer` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| `STATE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#clear-cockpit-state) |

## cockpit upgrade

Show the steps to upgrade cockpit without applying them.

Status: experimental. This interface may change before a stable release.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--release-evidence` | string | unset |
| `--release-evidence-sha256` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |

## cockpit sync

Write the generated stack and agent files from cockpit.toml.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--dry-run` | boolean | `false` |
| `--adopt` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_APPROVAL_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_ARTIFACT` | a person runs npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> --interactive in a terminal and approves the stale-removal digest it shows |
| `MCP_APPROVAL_UNKNOWN` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#mcp-and-restrictions) |
| `MCP_COMMAND_CONFLICT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#mcp-and-restrictions) |
| `MCP_DECLARATION_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#mcp-and-restrictions) |

## cockpit check

Report generated files that no longer match cockpit.toml.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `CODEX_HOOK_UNTRUSTED` | if you use Codex in this cockpit, a person runs codex -C <cockpit root> in a terminal (not codex exec), trusts the folder if asked, and chooses "Trust all and continue" when Codex shows "Hooks need review" (or enables and trusts the hook in its /hooks view); then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit selftest

Test whether agent tools enforce the generated controls.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--probe-specifications` | string | unset |
| `--write-probe-specifications` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |

## cockpit runtime

Measure the local container runtime (runtime measure) and record the result for this machine.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--image` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |

## cockpit up

Start or resume the declared environment.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |

## cockpit preflight

Check that the environment is healthy and ready for work.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `COCKPIT_LAUNCHER_UNPROVEN` | run cockpit as ./node_modules/.bin/cockpit <command> --config <your cockpit.toml> from the cockpit root, or remove what stops npx from proving it: a .npmrc in the cockpit root, a bin or directories.bin in its package.json, or a node_modules/.bin/cockpit that npm install did not link to the installed package |
| `CODEX_HOOK_UNTRUSTED` | if you use Codex in this cockpit, a person runs codex -C <cockpit root> in a terminal (not codex exec), trusts the folder if asked, and chooses "Trust all and continue" when Codex shows "Hooks need review" (or enables and trusts the hook in its /hooks view); then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EVALUATOR_UNAVAILABLE` | install the Codex CLI with npm install -g @openai/codex, sign in with codex login, then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |

## cockpit session

Keep the environment available for one command, then release it.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |

## cockpit logs

Show recent logs for one declared service.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--service` | string | unset |
| `--tail` | string | `"100"` |
| `--since` | string | `"15m"` |
| `--follow` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_APPROVAL_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_ARTIFACT` | a person runs npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> --interactive in a terminal and approves the stale-removal digest it shows |
| `LOGS_TRUNCATED` | lower --tail to the number of recent records you need, or read the older records from the container runtime directly |
| `MCP_APPROVAL_UNKNOWN` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#mcp-and-restrictions) |

## cockpit sleep

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |

## cockpit down

Stop and remove the stack (on the active local Docker context).

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit reset

Preview a reset, or approve that exact preview interactively (on the active local Docker context).

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |

## cockpit doctor

Report environment problems without changing anything.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `COCKPIT_LAUNCHER_UNPROVEN` | run cockpit as ./node_modules/.bin/cockpit <command> --config <your cockpit.toml> from the cockpit root, or remove what stops npx from proving it: a .npmrc in the cockpit root, a bin or directories.bin in its package.json, or a node_modules/.bin/cockpit that npm install did not link to the installed package |
| `CODEX_HOOK_UNTRUSTED` | if you use Codex in this cockpit, a person runs codex -C <cockpit root> in a terminal (not codex exec), trusts the folder if asked, and chooses "Trust all and continue" when Codex shows "Hooks need review" (or enables and trusts the hook in its /hooks view); then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `DECLARATION_UNCONFIRMED` | confirm each value with whoever owns the product and correct it in cockpit.toml if it is wrong, delete each confirmed entry from unconfirmed, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EVALUATOR_UNAVAILABLE` | install the Codex CLI with npm install -g @openai/codex, sign in with codex login, then run npx --no cockpit doctor --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit baseline-record

Record an explicitly confirmed environment baseline.

Status: experimental. This interface may change before a stable release.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |

## cockpit test-run

Run a declared product test gate and report which tests it selected.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--gate` | string | unset |
| `--mode` | string | `"canonical"` |
| `--select` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |

| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |

## cockpit work status

Report current work-order state.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit work accept

Interactively accept the exact current work order.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_APPROVAL_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |

## cockpit work resume

Resume the next executable step of the single active work order.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |

## cockpit work recover

Inspect or explicitly recover one interrupted work lock.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--lock` | string | unset |
| `--apply` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `GENERATED_STALE_APPROVAL_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |

## cockpit work execute

Execute one accepted work-order step.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |
| `--approach` | string | unset |

| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |

## cockpit work answer

Interactively record a person's answer to an open gap, or their decision.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |
| `--event-file` | string | unset |
| `--interactive` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit work review

Review the current accepted work order.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |

## cockpit work reverse

Reverse a recorded work-order sweep.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

| `GENERATED_STALE_ARTIFACT` | a person runs npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> --interactive in a terminal and approves the stale-removal digest it shows |

| `WORK_GRADE_UNSATISFIED` | read result.criteria: fix the product for a criterion that failed after execution, make a check that never ran runnable, then rerun npx --no cockpit work grade --config <your cockpit.toml> --work-order <id> |

## cockpit work programme-mint

Mint the next declared programme work order.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--programme` | string | unset |
| `--item` | string | unset |
| `--candidate` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit work metrics

Report work-order metrics.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

## cockpit work grade

Independently grade the current accepted work order.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--work-order` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

## cockpit browser drive

Drive the declared application browser surfaces.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--role` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit browser accessibility

Collect accessibility observations from the application.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--role` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |

## cockpit browser debugger

Prepare an explicitly requested browser debugger.

Reads `cockpit.toml` from `--config`.

| Flag | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string | unset |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` |
| `--role` | string | unset |

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | success |
| 2 | failure |
| 130 | cancelled |

| Diagnostic | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| `CLAIM_CO_TENANT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
| `ENVIRONMENT_NOT_DECLARED` | declare environment.compose_files = ["compose.yml"] to run your own Compose file, or [environment.generated] to have cockpit render one, then run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `EXECUTION_TERMINATION_UNCONFIRMED` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#merge-ownership-and-generation) |
| `GENERATED_ARTIFACT_DRIFT` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#generated_artifact_drift) |
| `GENERATED_DECLARATION_MISSING` | declare [environment.generated] for the runner, or remove browser.endpoint |
| `GENERATED_HOST_EXECUTABLE_UNSUPPORTED` | make argv[0] of the host operation "node", or run the command in a service: set location = "in-stack" and service to a generated service whose image has the tool |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_DRIFT` | run npx --no cockpit sync --config <your cockpit.toml> |
| `GENERATED_OWNERSHIP_INVALID` | [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md#common-refusal-guidance) |
